changelog.en: Fixed 9 issues: songs play, live-room crash, music player rebuilt, live swipe, slow video open, live portrait entry, landscape, video fade, player fullscreen. TMDB removed (Douban only). 3 switchable players (MPV/IJK/AVPlayer). 120Hz locked. Playlist plaza + Kugou, Daily Picks, music home rebuilt. Liquid Glass. Search infinite scroll. Artist/album pages rebuilt. Audio quality selector.
changelog.tw: 修復 9 個問題：歌曲播放、直播閃退、音樂播放器重做、直播滑動誤觸、影視打開慢、直播間豎屏進入、橫屏、影視漸變、播放器全屏。TMDB 移除改豆瓣。三播放器 MPV/IJK/AVPlayer 可切換。120Hz 鎖定。歌單廣場+酷狗、每日推薦、音樂首頁重做。Liquid Glass。搜尋無限滾動。歌手/專輯頁重做。音質選擇器。
